verses: Qasam hai uss raat ki jab cha jaye
Aur qasam hai din ki jab roshan ho
Aur qasam hai uss zaat ki jiss ney nurr o madah ko peda kiya
Yaqeenan tumhari koshish mukhtalif qasam ki hai
Jiss ney diya (Allah ki raah mein) aur dara (apney rab say)
Aur nek baat ki tasdeeq kerta rahey ga
To hum bhi uss ko aasan raastay ki sahoolat den gay
Lekin jiss ney bakheeli ki aur bey perwahi barti
Aur nek baat ki takzeeb ki
To hum bhi uss ki tangi o mushkil kay saman mayassar ker den gay
Uss ka maal ussay (ondha) girney kay waqt kuch kaam na aaye ga
Be-shak raah dikha dena humaray zimmay hai
Aur humaray hi hath aakhirat aur duniya hai
Mein ney to tumhen sholay marti hui aag say dara diya hai
Jiss mein sirf o hi badbakht dakhil hoga
Jiss ney jhutlaya aur (uss ki pairwee say) mun pher liya
Aur uss say aisa shakhs door rakha jaye ga jo bara perhezgar ho ga
Jo paki hasil kerney kay liye apna maal deta hai
Kissi ka uss per koi ehsan nahi kay jiss ka badla diya jaa raha ho
Balkay)yeh sirf apney perwerdigar buzurg o buland ki raza chahaney kay liye
Yaqeenan woh (Allah bhi) unqareeb mand ho jaye ga
